subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Pentacarbonylmanganese radical（•Mn(CO)₅）？
A. Square pyramidal
B. Trigonal bipyramidal
C. Linear
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Square pyramidal. Covalent count: Mn (group 7) 7 e; 5 × CO (L) 10 e: 17 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Mn(0), d⁷; d⁷ + 10 e from the ligands = 17 e. Made by breaking the Mn–Mn bond of Mn₂(CO)₁₀ with light; it dimerises back.
